description: See which bb server you are on and switch to another server on your account in one click. A strip above the sidebar footer shows the current server's name, address, online status, and your GitHub avatar. Click it to list the other servers on your bb account; offline servers are greyed out, and in the desktop app the switch goes through the app's own server menu. Give each server its own colored ring, from seven presets, a custom color, or a two-color gradient, in a picker beside the sidebar or with the bb server-switcher ring command. Requires a bb signed in to a bb account with the bundled bb connect plugin enabled.
